decisions.reason: As a newly launched operator line with several models and its own page, it looks like a strategically backed core extension whose uncertainty has not yet resolved and whose platform can be carried at relatively low cost.

The solid wood sectional garage door is a niche but still close to the firm's customization-focused core business, so management would likely keep the option open a bit longer despite somewhat higher complexity and narrower demand.

A garage door operator with remote control appears highly overlapping with the broader operator line, so with several other new options available the firm would be inclined to stop a weaker stand-alone variant and fold resources back into the main range.

This glazed industrial sectional door was only lightly presented and seems redundant with another glazed industrial door offering, so the option value looks limited relative to the benefit of reallocating resources.

The glazed insulated industrial sectional door is differentiated by insulation and fits the firm's commercial, compliance and building-performance positioning, so uncertainty about its value still justifies keeping it on the market.

Because this glazed industrial sectional door received a page of its own and sits squarely within the firm's established industrial door capabilities, management would likely continue it while market feedback is still forming.
